title: Zod resolvers
objective: Use zodResolver with distinct schema input and transformed output types; validate unknown values at the HTTP boundary too.
predict: A title containing spaces only must be blocked before POST, while a valid padded title becomes trimmed in handleSubmit.
expectedBehavior: The string `  done ` must be transformed to `done`. `   ` and a 101-character title must not invoke the submit callback. Server 422 must still be handled.
commonFailure: The form has no resolver, so a whitespace title reaches the submit handler.
securityBoundary: zodResolver is not authorization or persistence. The loopback API rejects invalid title/priority independently and must not trust the browser schema.
